metadata.title: TreeQuery
metadata.description: TreeQuery allows you to build SOQL queries, using 'selectors', powered by Where-Object and Powershell. Use TreeQuery when you don't know what query you want, don't know how to write it properly, or just don't feel like writing tens of hundreds of queries (all with the correct fields, references, child relationships, etc).
